CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
   D. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing values? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Sharing values has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Sharing values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing values.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   B. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.
   C. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

7. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   D. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

9. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.
   D. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   D. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of of Jesus Christ.
   C. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)
   A. Say Wedding has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Wedding to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wedding.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.
   C. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.
   B. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain The Bible Story; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
